programmes.d: Josh is knocked out by a posse who wants his prisoner.
Josh needs to get his wounded prisoner to Bannach in three days to prevent an innocent man from hanging.
Josh rides into a small town looking for Vic Warsaw but is told that Warsaw was killed the night before.
4 men break out of prison looking for revenge against Aben Starr who turned them in.
Josh is resting when two bounty hunters bring in a dead man. The sheriff wants nothing to do with the pair.
A grieving father who is the town drunk hires Josh Randall with his last $30 to find his murdered son's body.
At the request of his friend's wife, Randall comes to protect a war buddy in his bid for the town's mayoralty.
Josh honors a dying friend's request to return his body to Cameron and the townspeople believe Josh killed him
Josh is approached by the wife of a man eager to turn himself in, provided Josh split the bounty with his wife
A man with unwavering faith in a legend about lost treasure hires Josh to lead his family on an expedition.
When a runaway is framed for killing a Pinkerton agent, Randall turns detective to uncover the real killer.
Josh is requested to meet a famous singer in Denver who has a job for him.
Josh comes to the aid of an old friend who is being strong-armed into selling the Outrider Hotel and Saloon.
Josh goes into the Apache camp to win the hand of a woman the Indians kidnapped as a child.
Pursuing killer Joe Collins, Josh is followed by a man who believes Collins could be his lost son.
A religious cult cast lots and it falls upon a young woman to act as its angel of vengeance.
A young orphan girl wants Josh to find the parents she insists are still alive.
A father hires Josh to retrieve his son, an ideologue being used by plunderers to recruit freedom fighters.
Josh's browbeating about ending a decades-long feud gets him drafted to reconcile the hate-fueled hillbillies.
To track down a cheating gambler and recover his money, Randall befriends the card sharp's stepson.
Josh pleads with the parents of a boy with appendicitis to let the doctor operate.
Josh tries to find a beautiful bride for his bashful buddy Charlie, the homeliest man in the West.
Randall portrays a prisoner in order to trick his cellmate into leading authorities to the $50,000 he stole.
Randall rescues Jake Pringle and learns he's not the only one with an interest in keeping the killer alive.
Rogue City celebrates Randall for bringing in killer Jumbo Kane, but turns on Josh when Kane breaks loose.
Randall is rooked out of his bounty by crafty criminal Hunt Willis and his accomplice.
After losing a quick draw contest, Josh serves as guide for a dandified East Coast gun salesman.
On the trail of a Cavalry deserter, Josh rides into a town ruled as a fiefdom of its psychopathic marshal.
Hired by a father to bring back the man who killed his son, Josh is surprised when he doesn't get paid.
Josh must bring a man back for murder. He has to outwit men bent on claiming the bounty.
Josh brings a wanted man in to the Mesa City Sheriff, only to find he killed the sheriff's brother.
Josh looks for a man bitten by a rabid dog. He learns the law wanted him to lead them to his outlaw brother.
A man shoots his brother over property and blames it on an Indian who reclaimed his horse the man stole.
Josh is captured and forced to work on a chain gang in a gold mine.
Randall is tracking an escape artist who distracts a town, letting three guys rob the bank.
Josh signs on to help an amnesiac discover his identity.
After her father is murdered, a daughter wants immediate justice rather than wait for the wheels of justice.
Josh is determined to debunk the menace posed by a marauding monster that has smashed mining camps.
Josh hires out for $100/day to find a woman who may be dead.
Josh brings in "Doc" Phillips hoping he can lure Clell Fanning out as he has an old score to settle with Clell
Josh is arrested on a bogus horse-stealing charge.
To net a $1000 reward, Josh saves Tolliver Bender from a hanging so he can testify in a trial.
A woman hires Josh to clear her father on a false murder charge in a town that is not very welcoming.
Josh is hired to chase a killer by his brother, who is about to hang for a crime his brother committed.
Josh and Jason are on the trail of a karate expert accused of killing his employer.
Randall learns "hate comes high" in a town who have hired killers to murder their fellow resident.
Josh captures a wanted recruit and returns him to the Army, but the Captain refuses to pay.
Josh and Jason track a fugitive in Texas wanted for murder in Arizona, but his wife claims he is innocent.
A dying man offers Josh $2000 to find his son, who ran away 15 years ago.
Josh and Jason are escorting prisoners to Leavenworth prison when a stranger begins following along behind.
